svg.aria-label: High Style Cowl cable chart, 26 stitches by 39 rounds
svg.title: High Style Cowl — Cable Chart
svg.desc: 26-stitch repeat worked 5 times around over 39 rounds. Worked in the round; read right to left, bottom to top.
svg.text: 26-st repeat · 39 rounds · worked 5 times around (130 sts)
Worked in the round — every round is a right-side round; read right to left, bottom to top.
6-st RC — Sl 3 sts to cn, hold to back, k3, k3 from cn
6-st LC — Sl 3 sts to cn, hold to front, k3, k3 from cn
11-st RC — Sl 6 sts to cn, hold to back, k5, k6 from cn
11-st LC — Sl 5 sts to cn, hold to front, k6, k5 from cn
The 11-st crosses on Rnds 10 and 30 are worked all knit — the purl columns land in a new place, which is what makes the ropes travel.
